notes: First-pass outline for a research article at 4000 target words; the section targets sum to 4500, inside the ±15 percent gate.

task.title: Outline the article structure
task.instructions: Produce a section outline with a word target and the claims each section must establish.
acceptance: Every required research section has a title and a word target
The targets sum to the brief's target words within 15 percent

brief.topic: Token-frugal orchestration for agentic academic writing
brief.audience: graduate students and applied NLP practitioners
must_avoid: claims about model capabilities without evidence

entry.summary: Planned eight research sections from the rubric; targets sum to 4500 words, inside the brief's tolerance.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.goal: Frame the question and state the contribution.
key_claims: Iterative writing needs a token budget, not only a quality target.
A reference-passing controller keeps prompt cost linear in iteration count.
required_sources: One source on agentic writing controllers.

sections.title: Related Work
sections.goal: Place the controller among agentic writing and scheduling work.
key_claims: Earlier systems optimise output quality and ignore context growth.
Token-aware scheduling treats cost as a first-class constraint.

sections.title: Methodology
sections.goal: Describe the controller, the ledger and the measurement.
key_claims: Five roles execute a plan written by a planning-only model.
Every call reserves tokens before it runs and settles after.
required_sources: The system description in this article.
The pilot run data from the brief.

sections.title: Results
sections.goal: Report the pilot run: iterations, spend and Q.
key_claims: Eleven iterations reached Q 81 from Q 68.
Total spend stayed inside one run budget.
required_sources: Pilot run data from the brief.

sections.title: Discussion
sections.goal: Explain why the trade holds and when it would not.
key_claims: Linear prompt growth explains the flat cost per iteration.
The design fails when sources must be re-read rather than referenced.

sections.title: Limitations
sections.goal: State what one pilot run cannot establish.
key_claims: One pilot run cannot separate the controller from the model used.
Quality was scored by a model, not by expert readers.
required_sources: Limitations of the evaluation in this article.

sections.title: Conclusion
sections.goal: Restate the contribution and the next measurement.
key_claims: Budgeted orchestration makes iteration cost visible and comparable.
The next step is a reader study on the same ledger.

sections.title: References
sections.goal: Hold the reference list generated from source cards.
key_claims: Every cited card has one entry.
No entry appears without a citation.
required_sources: All source cards cited in the text.
